predicate.label: chairperson of
predicate.definition: Person X holds or held the office of chair or chairperson of organization or governing body Y.
includes: past tenure or resignation from that office
ambiguous: ambiguous successor or appointment that does not establish tenure
predicate.notes: Do not widen a prior specific-chair declaration to managerial office because its facts would then score better.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit chair/chairman/chairwoman/chairperson; co-chair if explicit; past tenure or resignation from that office. Excludes: president/head/executive/director alone; founder/owner/member alone; nomination/candidacy alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: ambiguous successor or appointment that does not establish tenure; chair of an omitted subunit. Do not widen a prior specific-chair declaration to managerial office because its facts would then score better.

rationale: Explicit chairman title dominates, including prior office shown by retirement/replacement; generic center possession does not establish chairmanship.
